product.title: Chicago Gangster and Food Walking Tour

description.text: Explore Chicago's Prohibition-era past on a walking tour that pairs mob history with tastings at local eateries. Your guide recounts stories of Al Capone, the St. Valentine's Day Massacre, and Loop speakeasies while you sample Chicago favorites in River North and the Theatre District. Stops include landmark hotels and streets where gangsters once operated openly. This premium food-and-history format suits travelers who want culture and cuisine in one three-hour outing.

highlights: Gangster history walking tour with food tastings
Stories of Al Capone and Prohibition-era Chicago
Palmer House Hilton and Loop landmark stops
Curated bites at local Chicago restaurants
Three-hour premium food and history format
